import datetime
import math
import urllib.request
import json
import ephem
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

def ottieni_posizione():
    """Ottiene le coordinate approssimative in base all'indirizzo IP."""
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request("https://ipapi.co/json/", headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
            data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
            return float(data['latitude']), float(data['longitude']), f"{data['city']}, {data['country_name']}"
    except Exception:
        return 45.5841, 9.2744, "Posizione predefinita (Italia)"

def genera_mappa_cielo():
    lat, lon, citta = ottieni_posizione()
    
    osservatore = ephem.Observer()
    osservatore.lat = str(lat)
    osservatore.lon = str(lon)
    osservatore.date = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    
    # Oggetti celesti (Corpo, Colore, Dimensione punto)
    oggetti = {
        "Sole": (ephem.Sun(), "#FFD700", 160),
        "Luna": (ephem.Moon(), "#E0E0E0", 130),
        "Mercurio": (ephem.Mercury(), "#FFA500", 60),
        "Venere": (ephem.Venus(), "#FFF8DC", 90),
        "Marte": (ephem.Mars(), "#FF4500", 70),
        "Giove": (ephem.Jupiter(), "#D2B48C", 100),
        "Saturno": (ephem.Saturn(), "#F0E68C", 85),
        "Sirio": (ephem.star("Sirius"), "#00FFFF", 50),
        "Betelgeuse": (ephem.star("Betelgeuse"), "#FF6347", 50),
        "Vega": (ephem.star("Vega"), "#1E90FF", 50),
        "Stella Polare": (ephem.star("Polaris"), "#FFFFFF", 40)
    }

    # Creazione della figura e assi polari
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9, 9), facecolor='#0b0d1b')
    ax = fig.add_subplot(111, polar=True, facecolor='#050714')

    # Configurazione coordinate astronomiche: Nord in alto, rotazione oraria
    ax.set_theta_zero_location('N')
    ax.set_theta_direction(-1)
    
    # Limite raggio: 0 (Zenit = 90°) -> 90 (Orizzonte = 0°)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 90)
    ax.set_yticks([30, 60, 90])  
    ax.set_yticklabels(['60°', '30°', '0° (Orizzonte)'], color='#8a8dA0', fontsize=9)
    ax.tick_params(colors='white')
    ax.grid(color='#2a2d45', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8)

    # Punti cardinali
    ax.set_xticklabels(['N', 'NE', 'E', 'SE', 'S', 'SO', 'O', 'NO'], color='white', weight='bold')

    visibili = 0
    for nome, (corpo, colore, dimensione) in oggetti.items():
        corpo.compute(osservatore)
        alt_deg = math.degrees(float(corpo.alt))
        az_deg = math.degrees(float(corpo.az))
        
        # Plot solo degli oggetti sopra l'orizzonte
        if alt_deg > 0:
            visibili += 1
            az_rad = math.radians(az_deg)
            raggio = 90 - alt_deg  # Inversione: 0 al centro, 90 al bordo
            
            ax.scatter(az_rad, raggio, color=colore, s=dimensione, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)
            ax.annotate(f" {nome}", (az_rad, raggio), color='white', fontsize=10, weight='bold', zorder=4)

    plt.title(f"Mappa del Cielo - {citta}\n{osservatore.date} UTC (Oggetti visibili: {visibili})", 
              color='white', pad=25, fontsize=13, weight='bold')
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    genera_mappa_cielo()

from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from starplot import HorizonPlot, Observer, _
from starplot.styles import PlotStyle, extensions

style = PlotStyle().extend(
    extensions.BLUE_GOLD,
    extensions.MAP,
    extensions.GRADIENT_PRE_DAWN,
)

dt = datetime(2025, 7, 26, 23, 30, 0, 0, tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Europe/London"))

observer = Observer(
    lat=55.079112,  # Stonehaugh, England
    lon=-2.327469,
    dt=dt,
)

p = HorizonPlot(
    altitude=(0, 60),
    azimuth=(135, 225),
    observer=observer,
    style=style,
    resolution=3200,
    scale=0.9,
)

p.constellations()
p.milky_way()

p.stars(
    where=[_.magnitude < 5],
    where_labels=[_.magnitude < 2],
    style__marker__symbol="star_4",
)

p.messier(
    where=[_.magnitude < 11],
    where_true_size=[False],
)

p.constellation_labels()
p.horizon(labels={180: "SOUTH"})

import datetime
import json
import math
import urllib.request
import ephem


def get_current_location():
    """Detect latitude, longitude, and city via IP address with fallback."""
    try:
        url = "http://ip-api.com/json/"
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=5) as response:
            data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
            return data.get("lat"), data.get("lon"), data.get("city", "Unknown")
    except Exception:
        # Default coordinates if IP lookup fails (e.g., Monza, Italy)
        return 45.5841, 9.2744, "Default Location"


def check_planets():
    lat, lon, city = get_current_location()
    now_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    # Set up observer
    observer = ephem.Observer()
    observer.lat = str(lat)
    observer.lon = str(lon)
    observer.date = now_utc

    planets = {
        "Mercury": ephem.Mercury(),
        "Venus": ephem.Venus(),
        "Mars": ephem.Mars(),
        "Jupiter": ephem.Jupiter(),
        "Saturn": ephem.Saturn(),
        "Uranus": ephem.Uranus(),
        "Neptune": ephem.Neptune(),
    }

    print(f"Location: {city} (Lat: {lat:.2f}, Lon: {lon:.2f})")
    print(f"UTC Time: {now_utc.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}\n")
    print(f"{'Planet':<10} | {'Status':<6} | {'Altitude':<10} | {'Azimuth':<10}")
    print("-" * 45)

    for name, body in planets.items():
        body.compute(observer)
        alt_deg = math.degrees(float(body.alt))
        az_deg = math.degrees(float(body.az))

        status = "UP" if alt_deg > 0 else "DOWN"
        print(
            f"{name:<10} | {status:<6} | {alt_deg:6.1f}°    | {az_deg:6.1f}°"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    check_planets()

import requests

import requests
from datetime import datetime
from skyfield.api import load, wgs84

import requests

# Definisci un User-Agent valido per evitare il blocco "Access Blocked"
HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
}


def get_iss_location():
    url = "http://api.open-notify.org/iss-now.json"
    try:
        # Passa gli headers nella richiesta HTTP
        response = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=5)

        # Controlla se il server ha risposto con successo (200 OK)
        response.raise_for_status()

        data = response.json()
        lat = float(data["iss_position"]["latitude"])
        lon = float(data["iss_position"]["longitude"])

        print(f"Posizione ISS: Lat {lat}, Lon {lon}")
        return lat, lon

    except requests.exceptions.HTTPError as err:
        print(f"Errore di accesso HTTP: {err}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Errore: {e}")


def get_astronauts():
    """Recupera la lista degli astronauti a bordo della ISS."""
    url = "http://api.open-notify.org/astros.json"
    try:
        response = requests.get(url, timeout=5)
        data = response.json()
        iss_crew = [p for p in data.get("people", []) if p.get("craft") == "ISS"]

        print("\n" + "=" * 60)
        print(f" ASTRONAUTI A BORDO DELLA ISS ({len(iss_crew)} presenti)")
        print("=" * 60)
        for person in iss_crew:
            print(f" • {person['name']}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Errore nel recupero degli astronauti: {e}")

def get_next_iss_passes(user_lat: float, user_lon: float, days: int = 3, min_altitude_deg: float = 10.0):
    """
    Calcola i prossimi passaggi della ISS sopra le coordinate indicate
    usando i dati orbitali TLE aggiornati dal NORAD / CelesTrak.
    """
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print(f" PROSSIMI PASSAGGI ISS (Lat: {user_lat:.4f}°, Lon: {user_lon:.4f}°)")
    print("=" * 60)

    try:
        # Scarica i dati TLE aggiornati della ISS da Celestrak
        stations_url = 'https://celestrak.org/NORAD/elements/gp.php?NAME=ISS%20(ZARYA)&FORMAT=tle'
        satellites = load.tle_file(stations_url)
        iss = satellites[0]

        ts = load.timescale()
        t0 = ts.now()
        t1 = ts.utc(t0.utc_datetime().year, t0.utc_datetime().month, t0.utc_datetime().day + days)

        # Definisci la posizione dell'osservatore
        observer = wgs84.latlon(user_lat, user_lon)

        # Trova gli eventi di passaggio (0: sorge, 1: culmine/altezza max, 2: tramonta)
        times, events = iss.find_events(observer, t0, t1, altitude_degrees=min_altitude_deg)

        current_pass = {}
        pass_count = 0

        for time_obj, event_type in zip(times, events):
            dt_local = time_obj.astimezone()  # Converte nell'ora locale della macchina

            if event_type == 0:  # Sorge sopra l'orizzonte
                current_pass = {'start': dt_local}
            elif event_type == 1:  # Punto di massima altezza (Culmine)
                # Calcola l'altezza massima in gradi sopra l'orizzonte
                difference = iss - observer
                topocentric = difference.at(time_obj)
                alt, az, _ = topocentric.altaz()
                current_pass['max_alt'] = alt.degrees
                current_pass['max_time'] = dt_local
            elif event_type == 2:  # Tramonta sotto l'orizzonte
                current_pass['end'] = dt_local
                pass_count += 1
                
                print(f"\nPassaggio #{pass_count}:")
                print(f"  • Inizio     : {current_pass['start'].strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')}")
                print(f"  • Culmine    : {current_pass['max_time'].strftime('%H:%M:%S')} (Altezza max: {current_pass['max_alt']:.1f}°)")
                print(f"  • Fine       : {current_pass['end'].strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")

        if pass_count == 0:
            print("Nessun passaggio visibile trovato nei prossimi giorni.")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Errore durante il calcolo dei passaggi: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    get_iss_location_and_telemetry()
    get_astronauts()

    # Coordinate di riferimento (Esempio: Milano / Monza ~ 45.58° N, 9.27° E)
    # Sostituisci con la tua latitudine e longitudine precise
    MY_LATITUDE = 45.5833
    MY_LONGITUDE = 9.2736

    get_next_iss_passes(user_lat=MY_LATITUDE, user_lon=MY_LONGITUDE, days=3)

import webbrowser
from datetime import datetime
import folium
import requests

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
}


def generate_iss_map():
    url = "http://api.open-notify.org/iss-now.json"
    try:
        # Aggiunto headers=HEADERS
        response = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=5)
        response.raise_for_status()

        data = response.json()
        lat = float(data["iss_position"]["latitude"])
        lon = float(data["iss_position"]["longitude"])
        timestamp = datetime.fromtimestamp(data["timestamp"]).strftime(
            "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
        )

        iss_map = folium.Map(location=[lat, lon], zoom_start=4)

        popup_text = f"<b>ISS</b><br>Lat: {lat}<br>Lon: {lon}<br>Data: {timestamp} UTC"
        folium.Marker(
            location=[lat, lon],
            popup=popup_text,
            icon=folium.Icon(color="red", icon="info-sign"),
        ).add_to(iss_map)

        filename = "mappa_iss.html"
        iss_map.save(filename)
        print("Mappa generata con successo!")
        webbrowser.open(filename)

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Errore: {e}")
        
if __name__ == "__main__":
    generate_iss_map()
